system.description: Allows the necromancer to harvest one to four Blood Traits' worth of entropic energy (usable only to fuel Disciplines, not for healing or Attribute increases) from a site recently touched by death, temporarily depleting the location's necromantic potency. Alternatively, the necromancer may attack a wraith as if feeding; the wraith must defeat her in a Willpower Challenge or be immobilized while she drains its 10-Trait Entropy pool, utterly destroying it once emptied (no Labyrinth or Harrowing). Usable alongside Ash Path Necromancy while traveling the Shadowlands.
